messages:
Maya Lopez: Heads-up: sudden p95 token latency increase on /v1/complete route=help-summarize at 2025-01-12T15:03:19Z. Small window (~8m).

Tariq Ahmed: Any deployments? kernel selector changes? batching?

Becky Sun: No deploys. kvcache metrics show shard-12 eviction burst and reuse_by_route heatmap shows route "news-collector" spiking reuse on that shard.

Maya Lopez: PromQL I ran for shard evictions:
```
sum(rate(prefix_kvcache_evictions_total{shard="shard-12"}[1m]))
```
Eviction rate spiked 12x.

Tariq Ahmed: Batcher logs show target_batch_ms collapsed from 40ms -> 8ms during the window. More small batches -> higher per-token overhead. Also saw kernel fallback entries: kernel_selector logged fallback "amx_fast" -> "fp16_safe" for several long-seq requests.

Becky Sun: Can we split token_latency by kv_hit and by kernel_variant? Proposed histogram for p95 by kv_hit:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="help-summarize"}[5m])) by (le, kv_hit))
```
And include kernel_variant label on token_latency metric.

Maya Lopez: Add panel: shard-level eviction + mem_usage, reuse_by_route heatmap, p95 by kv_hit/kernel_variant. Also want a timeseries showing average batch size and batcher_window_ms.

Tariq Ahmed: Draft alert for staging:
```
- alert: KVShardRegression
  expr: |
    (
      histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="help-summarize"}[5m])) by (le))
      > histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="help-summarize"}[5m])) by (le)) offset 10m * 1.35
    )
    and (
      sum(rate(prefix_kvcache_hits_total{route="help-summarize"}[5m]))
      / sum(rate(prefix_kvcache_requests_total{route="help-summarize"}[5m])) < 0.75
    )
  for: 3m
  labels: {severity: warning}
  annotations: {summary: "token p95 up with low prefix kvcache hit rate"}
```

perf-bot: profile-run queued id=20077 route=help-summarize dur=60s. Will post flamegraphs.

SRE Bot: Temporarily added +10% capacity to shard-12. Monitor hit rate and evictions.

Becky Sun: After capacity bump, eviction rate down ~6x and hit rate recovered to ~0.86 after ~4m. Batch-size still down; p95 improved but not fully back to baseline due to kernel fallbacks and smaller batches.

Maya Lopez: Next steps: (1) add kernel_variant label to token metrics; (2) land dashboard panels (reuse heatmap + hit/miss p95 + batch-size); (3) analyze perf-bot flamegraph and correlate kernel timelines with kv misses; (4) run a staged synthetic with warm prefixes to confirm whether reuse_by_route partitioning triggers shard hotspots.

Tariq Ahmed: I'll open a PR for the metric label + ingestion change and a dashboard JSON in monitoring repo. Will file a postmortem if similar recurrence within 48h.

Maya Lopez: Thanks. Keep this thread updated with perf-bot outputs. If alert fires escalate to oncall SRE. :eyes:
